metadata.title: Quality Stock ETFs Stand Out as AI Stocks Wobble<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
These ETFs Cast a Wide Net—and Are Beating the S&P 500
Even as Claude developer Anthropic prepares to launch its massive initial public offering, technology stocks have been incredibly volatile —reflecting the seemingly endless market debate over what’s next for the artificial-intelligence trade.
